e.title: insurance-multivariate-conformal
e.summary: 多输出 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：LWC/GWC/Bonferroni 联合预测区域
e.summary_en: Multivariate conformal (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): LWC/GWC/Bonferroni joint prediction regions
e.summary_hk: 多輸出 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：LWC/GWC/Bonferroni 聯合預測區域
e.body:
insurance-multivariate-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做多输出保险模型的联合 conformal 预测区域：LWC（Lee et al.）、GWC、Bonferroni 方法——多个预测目标同时覆盖的保证。对 RIAA：保险模型常多输出（频率 + 严重度、多个险种）——联合覆盖（所有输出同时正确）比逐个区间更难；[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的高维分支；与 [[insurance-dependent-fs]]（频率-严重度联合）配套；适合多目标预测的研究场景。

## 同类工具
[[insurance-nflow]]、[[insurance-reconcile]]、[[insurance-scmoe]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
insurance-multivariate-conformal (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does joint conformal prediction regions for multi-output insurance models: LWC (Lee et al.), GWC, Bonferroni methods — guarantees that multiple prediction targets are covered simultaneously. For RIAA: insurance models are often multi-output (frequency + severity, multiple lines) — joint coverage (all outputs correct at once) is harder than per-output intervals; the high-dimensional branch of the [[insurance-conformal]] family; pairs with [[insurance-dependent-fs]] (joint frequency-severity); suits multi-target prediction research.

## Similar tools
[[insurance-nflow]]、[[insurance-reconcile]]、[[insurance-scmoe]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
insurance-multivariate-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做多輸出保險模型的聯合 conformal 預測區域：LWC（Lee et al.）、GWC、Bonferroni 方法——多個預測目標同時覆蓋的保證。對 RIAA：保險模型常多輸出（頻率 + 嚴重度、多個險種）——聯合覆蓋（所有輸出同時正確）比逐個區間更難；[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的高維分支；與 [[insurance-dependent-fs]]（頻率-嚴重度聯合）配套；適合多目標預測的研究場景。

## 同類工具
[[insurance-nflow]]、[[insurance-reconcile]]、[[insurance-scmoe]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
